title: SIL Intent
description: JSON Schema for SIL v1.0.0 Intent POST body (§5.4 of the specification)

intent.description: The action to perform (lowercase). See §5.4 Intent-to-Action Mapping for the full list.

target.description: The Id of the target object. Must match the Id property of an object in the current STF document.

params.description: Optional parameters for the action. Structure depends on the intent and the target's Expects declaration.

response_mode.description: Response mode. 'full' returns the complete page state (default). 'events' returns only the Events block.

state_version.description: Optional. The StateVersion from the last GET, for optimistic concurrency (§9.4). Experimental.
